old_problem: `TEMP_AMBIENT` can represent inlet, outlet, internal zone or rack/room probes whose values legitimately differ. The source lacks a physical probe map, airflow boundary, timing and tolerance policy. Cross-interface agreement alone cannot prove metrological accuracy. Historical review retained those project parameters and the 1/2/24 numbering gap as an Engineering Decision.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. Every probe can be parameterized by physical location/airflow boundary and mapped across full IB/OOB/Web inventories. Project SPEC defines population, expected reporting range, freshness and whether an independent calibrated reference is required for accuracy. Absent reference evidence never supports an accuracy claim. ED-03 allows these runtime bindings, ED-08 preserves Web visuals and ED-15 forbids invented tolerances. Criteria 1/2/24 remain explicit while missing numbers are not fabricated.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2020, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and ipmitool/OpenBMC documentation were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2021 / Wistron-BMC-01041-V002 / 0488a140e21f9fef.
Complete IPMI sensor reads are standard, but an ambient value is comparable only after binding inlet/outlet/front/rear/internal/rack location, airflow, workload and time.
IB, OOB and Web may share one underlying probe; their agreement proves interface parity, not sensor accuracy against physical air temperature.
Accuracy is graded only when the SPEC supplies a calibrated colocated reference, uncertainty/tolerance and stabilization rule; otherwise the test remains a reporting-parity check.
The source states SDR, Sensor List and Web parity; number 24 is retained as an editorial defect and does not define criteria 3–23.
No ipmitool, authentication, ambient/reference read, Web login/capture, heating/cooling/fan/airflow action, log clear, BMC, host or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Physical-location-bound ambient probe parity with optional calibrated accuracy comparison
test_case.purpose: Verify every required ambient probe is physically identified and reports SPEC-consistent name, description, temperature/state/threshold and freshness across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web; prove accuracy only when an approved colocated calibrated reference exists.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/chassis/rack identity and physical inlet/outlet/front/rear/internal-zone/room location plus airflow orientation of every required probe
Versioned ambient sensor population/range/state/threshold/update/freshness SPEC and per-probe IB-SDR/IB-list/OOB-SDR/OOB-list/Web crosswalk
Stable workload, fan/airflow and environment context with aligned sampling, cache/rounding/stale/unavailable/pagination rules
If accuracy is in scope: calibrated colocated reference ID/certificate, placement, uncertainty, stabilization time and approved tolerance
Approved ipmitool, trusted protected OOB/Web access, evidence hashes, retained thermal logs and human Web/verdict ownership
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind every ambient probe to exact physical location/airflow boundary and record stable workload/fan/environment context. Preserve logs. Capture complete untruncated aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist`/`sensor list`, retain raw outputs before TEMP_AMBIENT filtering, and capture every BMC Web Sensor page with probe location/time. Compare population, identity, units/value/state/threshold/freshness with SPEC and across views. If and only if required, record the calibrated colocated reference after stabilization and compare using approved uncertainty/tolerance. Do not assume the testcase title is a sensor, rely on grep/head alone, heat/cool/obstruct airflow/change fan policy, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: All required probes appear once at their correct physical locations and have aligned SPEC-valid IB/OOB/Web fields with complete visual evidence and no thermal alarm. When accuracy is in scope, each stabilized sensor-reference difference satisfies the approved tolerance; otherwise no accuracy claim is made.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS for reporting parity requires exact probe map, complete raw IB/OOB/Web evidence and all fields within SPEC/freshness rules. Accuracy PASS additionally requires calibrated colocated reference, uncertainty and tolerance. FAIL on wrong/unknown location, missing/extra/duplicate probe, stale/out-of-range value, cross-view mismatch, exceeded approved accuracy tolerance or incomplete evidence. Missing mapping/tolerance is NOT READY; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive read-only only; prohibit thermal stimulus, airflow obstruction, fan/thermal-policy changes, threshold writes and log clearing.
Bind every probe physically after full raw capture; use protected trusted access and stable environmental context.
Stop on ambiguous location, missing/duplicate/stale data, out-of-range temperature or thermal alarm.
No automatic retry; preserve first discrepancy, reference/environment context, Web evidence and logs.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant and SUT/BMC/chassis/rack identity plus physical probe/airflow map
Versioned sensor SPEC/five-view crosswalk and stable workload/fan/environment conditions
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR elist and Sensor list raw outputs, exits and hashes
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export with probe location and pagination
test_case.recovery: On wrong target/location, access, sensor/Web mismatch, reference issue, out-of-range value or thermal alarm, stop passive collection and preserve the first environment/state. Close/revoke sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not alter airflow/temperature/fans, clear logs or retry insecurely; escalate exact probe ID/location to thermal/BMC owners.

source_conflict.reason: A physical probe map and explicit reporting-versus-accuracy contract resolve interpretation without invented tolerance; complete written views remain and 1/2/24 is only a numbering defect.

blocked.reason: Probe mapping, reporting parity, optional metrology, safety and recovery are defined; exact locations/tolerances are runtime Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact probe locations/airflow map, sensor ranges/freshness/crosswalk, environment rules, and calibrated reference/tolerance only if accuracy is required.
